'''Vahl''' was a [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] who personified the [[Fire/Legends|fiery]], destructive aspect of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. She was worshiped by the [[Ember of Vahl]] cult, which primarily consisted of members of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Vahla]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Vahl was often portrayed as a female Vahla with [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and her worshipers manifested various [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] related to fire. Before the Ember of Vahl, the deity was worshiped by the ancestors of the cult, with that society eventually being decimated by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It was thought that Vahl herself had originally been a Vahla [[Force Adept|Force adept]] who led her people into taking control over their [[Vahla homeworld|homeworld]].

==Description==
[[File:Vahla.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Vahl was worshiped by the Ember of Vahl cult, who were predominantly members of the Vahla species (a Vahla Ember of Vahl cultist pictured).]]
Vahl was a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] worshiped by the cult known as the [[Ember of Vahl]]. She was an embodiment of [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] destruction brought about by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Members of the cult who drew upon their faith in their [[Gender/Legends|goddess]] could manifest such [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] as entering a [[Meditation/Legends|meditative]] trance by staring into a flame, becoming resistant to the effects of fire and heat, and imbuing their [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] with the sparks and flames of Vahl. The deity was commonly depicted as a mature female [[Vahla]]&mdash;a member of a nomadic [[near-Human]], [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that, as a whole, was innately affected by the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Such depictions often portrayed the goddess as possessing flowing ash-[[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and smoldering black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="LECG" />

Members of the Ember of Vahl were primarily Vahla. The cultists' faith led them to eschew advanced weaponry in favor of more simple ones, [[Death/Legends|sacrifice]] abducted people to their goddess, and treat the rare Vahla [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] with red hair as being blessed by Vahl. The cult was led by the coven of six priests known as the [[Chosen of Vahl]]. They were considered true disciples of the deity and displayed their faith and devotion by scarring themselves. The Chosen of Vahl used [[Farsight/Legends|farseeing]] to consult with their goddess.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
The ancestors of the Ember of Vahl were decadent and twisted individuals whose lives revolved around service to Vahl and involved dark side&ndash;driven destructive tendencies. Eventually, several [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] prior to [[137 ABY]], the Force-sensitive [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which adhered to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]], decimated the worshipers of Vahl. The descendants of that society became interstellar nomads who endlessly searched for their [[Vahla homeworld|lost homeworld]]. It was believed that Vahl herself had originally been a powerful Vahla [[Force Adept|Force adept]] who had led her people in assuming control over their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] prior to being destroyed by the Jedi.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vahl was introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LECG" />
